Well, everybody just keeps acting like this whole foreclosure thing is just about paperwork, right? Like it's just missed payments and late fees. But I know for a fact that the bank, the loan servicer, and even the people at my job have been quietly working together to push me out of my house. Speaking of stupid, my husband bought this new weed whacker last weekend. He went to that big hardware store on the edge of town instead of the one down the street, because he had a coupon. He spent three hours in the garage swearing at it. I told him he should just watch a YouTube video on how to do it. That's what I do when the self-checkout machines at the store break down and IT puts me on hold for an hour. You can learn how to fix anything on YouTube. My nephew learned how to rebuild a whole car engine just by watching videos. He bought this old Honda Civic that was completely rusted out, and he spent his entire summer in the driveway taking it apart. His mom was so mad because he got oil stains all over the concrete. Getting oil stains out of concrete is basically impossible. You can try that heavy-duty degreaser, but it just lightens it a little bit. We sell this industrial cleaner at my store, but Brenda keeps putting it in the wrong aisle. I swear, I have told her a hundred times that chemicals go in aisle four, not with the pet supplies. Imagine if someone accidentally bought bleach thinking it was dog shampoo? That would be a disaster. The liability alone... um... wait, what was I saying? Oh right, the bank and the foreclosure.
